name: ai-compiler-workbench
displayName: AI Compiler Workbench -- Agentic Graph Visualiser
description: Agentic pipeline that discovers HuggingFace models, checks nntrainer compatibility, and generates nntrainer-compatible C++ + an interactive knowledge graph, orchestrated with LangGraph/LangChain.

AI Compiler Workbench: Check / Install Python Dependencies

aiCompilerWorkbench.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter to use. The extension will offer to auto-install torch/transformers/langchain into it, but the interpreter itself must already exist.

aiCompilerWorkbench.anthropicApiKey.markdownDescription: Your own Anthropic API key. Used by the **Compatibility Agent** (op-fix suggestions), the **Auto-Fix Agent** (compiler-error patches), and the **Chat** panel. Leave blank to skip all three -- the deterministic agents (discovery, tracing, weight download/conversion, INI/C++/graph generation, compiling, profiling, artifacts) all work without it.

aiCompilerWorkbench.nntrainerPath.markdownDescription: Path to a local nntrainer install **prefix** (a directory containing `include/nntrainer` and `lib/`), built from [nntrainer/nntrainer](https://github.com/nntrainer/nntrainer) via `meson --prefix=<this path> build && ninja -C build install`. Required only for **Profile On-Device**; everything else works without it. If left blank, the extension will prompt you for it the first time you use that command -- including an option to build nntrainer from source automatically (Ubuntu only).

aiCompilerWorkbench.nntrainerRepoPath.markdownDescription: Path to a local clone (via `git clone`, not a downloaded zip -- submodules require real git metadata) of the [nntrainer/nntrainer](https://github.com/nntrainer/nntrainer) source repo. Used by **Build nntrainer From Source**; remembered so you aren't asked again on subsequent builds.

aiCompilerWorkbench.causallmProjectRoot.markdownDescription: Path to your CausalLM integration project (the one with `transformer.h`, `causal_lm.h`, `<arch>_causallm.h`), used only when **Install Generated Files** is enabled below. Generated CausalLM components (`generated_<arch>_causallm.{h,cpp}`) always get written to `<output>/generated/causallm/<arch>/` regardless of this setting -- this only controls whether they're *also* copied into your real project.

aiCompilerWorkbench.generatedHeaderDirec.description: Directory (relative to causallmProjectRoot) that generated .h files are copied into, when installGeneratedFiles is enabled.

aiCompilerWorkbench.generatedSourceDirec.description: Directory (relative to causallmProjectRoot) that generated .cpp files are copied into, when installGeneratedFiles is enabled.

aiCompilerWorkbench.installGeneratedFile.markdownDescription: When enabled, copies generated CausalLM `.h`/`.cpp` files into `causallmProjectRoot`'s generated-header/source directories after each run. **Off by default** -- this writes into a project outside the extension's own output directory, so it's opt-in rather than something a first run does silently.
